description: This Java class 'NoopExternalEventEnabled' extends 'PropertiesCondition' and determines whether external event producers (JMS or Kafka) are enabled based on properties. It specifically checks configuration properties related to external event producers to decide if external events are enabled or not.

classes.name: NoopExternalEventEnabled
classes.description: A condition class that evaluates whether external event producers (JMS or Kafka) are disabled based on properties.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the method to check if neither JMS nor Kafka external event producers are enabled based on the provided properties.

methods.name: getEffectiveJMSProperty
methods.description: Checks if the JMS external event producer is enabled in the given properties.

methods.name: getEffectiveKafkaProperty
methods.description: Checks if the Kafka external event producer is enabled in the given properties.
